title: OpenAI GPT model family
answer: OpenAI GPT is OpenAI's model line, with 56 versions listed in the OpenRouter catalog, the first released 2023-05-28 and the newest, GPT-6.1 Sol Pro, on 2026-09-29. Some versions publish open weights and others are API only.
licence: Some open weights, some API only

family_reading.text: OpenAI GPT spans 56 versions, and the whole family shows 38 of them supporting reasoning, 3 publishing open weights, and context windows from 4095 to 1050000 tokens. Inputs cover audio, image and text, outputs cover audio, image and text. The newest versions reach 1050000 token context and 128000 token output, with prices from $0.1 per million input and $0.5 output at the low end up to $30 input and $180 output at the high end. A LiveBench leaderboard row names GPT-5.6 Sol at 82.4. These facts suggest the family suits long document, audio and image work where reasoning matters, with cheap tiers for volume and costly tiers for demanding jobs. Limits are that most versions are API only, only 3 publish open weights, and top tiers are expensive.
